title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About BQI Tech 

We are a leading software development and IT consulting firm specializing in custom technology solutions for government agencies and businesses. We combine cutting-edge innovation, security-first approaches, and enterprise-level expertise to help organizations streamline operations, modernize legacy systems, and enhance digital transformation. 

We’re seeking talented and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about customer satisfaction and have a keen eye for detail. Join us in delivering successful solutions in the e-governments space. 

About the Role 

As a Salesforce Developer, you will: 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and understand business requirements, translating them into effective technical solutions within the Salesforce platform. 
  • Design, develop, and implement customized solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and other Salesforce technologies, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and maintainability. 
  • Drive the integration of third-party applications and data sources, expanding the capabilities of our Salesforce environment. 
  • Continuously optimize and enhance existing features to meet evolving business needs and industry best practices. 
  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring code quality, security, and performance. 
  • Stay current with Salesforce updates, trends, and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation. 

About You 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Developer, with a strong grasp of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and other relevant technologies. 
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I and/or Platform Developer II are a strong plus. 
  • Familiarity with Clariti Solutions or similar workflow automation tools is highly desirable. 
  • Solid understanding of software development best practices, including version control, testing, and documentation. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to dissect complex issues and provide effective solutions. 
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in an agile environment. 
  • Public sector experience with a focus on permitting, planning, licensing, and code enforcement is preferred. 

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive private medical insurance 
  • Pension 
  • Annual bonus 
  • Competitive holiday + Birtholiday 

Studies indicate that women are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet all the requirements. We encourage women to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. Your skills and perspective are valuable to us. 

BQI Tech is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

title: Trainee
description:
BQI Tech is software development and technology professional service company that specializes in delivering modern solutions and services to the State and Local Government in the Land Management, Business Licensing, Professional Licensing,and Asset Management spaces.

We’re seeking talented and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about customer satisfaction and have a keen eye for detail. Join us in delivering successful solutions in the e-governments space.

About the role:

• Review captured business requirements.

• Configure solutions that meet customer needs based on stories entered in JIRA or developed in Microsoft Word.

• Develop, test, and document complete solutions.

• Provide end user and technical documents on completed solutions.

• Participate in other technical components (Scripting, Data Conversion/Migration, Report Development)

About You

• Interest in Commercial Off the Shelf (COTS) software configuration.

• Knowledge of Report Development using SSRS or Crystal Reports.

• Interest in Land Management, Business Licensing, Professional Licensing, Code Enforcement.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology or related field.

• Strong written and verbal communication.

• Strong presentation experience.

• Experience with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies

• Basic JavaScript experience.

• SQL Script experience (Oracle or SQL Server)


BQI Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. BQI Technologies will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
